findings.title: Same null-delegate NPE remains in the paged subgroup stream methods
findings.body: The fix only guards getSubGroupsCount(). The three paged overloads (getSubGroupsStream(search, firstResult, maxResults) at line 256, getSubGroupsStream(firstResult, maxResults) at line 262, and getSubGroupsStream(search, exact, firstResult, maxResults) at line 268) still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. If the group was deleted concurrently and the cache entry is stale, modelSupplier.get() returns null and these throw the same NullPointerException the PR is meant to fix. The brief group listing path can reach these methods, so the same race can still surface there.

findings.title: Background reader thread is never joined or stopped on failure, and may spin forever
findings.body: The reader thread is started with new Thread(...).start() as a non-daemon thread and is never joined. It only stops when deletedAll is set at the end of the test. If any group removal throws, the main thread exits via exception before deletedAll.set(true), so the reader loops forever issuing admin requests and keeps the JVM alive. The test also does not register the created groups for cleanup, so a failure leaks them.

findings.title: Exceptions from the reader thread are checked before the thread has finished
findings.body: assertThat(caughtExceptions, empty()) runs right after deletedAll is set, but the reader thread may still be inside an in-flight request. Any exception raised by that last request, or by a request that runs after the assertion, is never checked. The thread should be joined before asserting so the result is deterministic.

findings.title: Unrelated dead-code removal bundled into an NPE fix
findings.body: The diff deletes the private helper groupMatchesSearchOrIsPathElement. It is unrelated to the concurrent NPE in the PR title and description. Removing it in the same change makes the PR harder to review and should be a separate change, or at least called out in the description.
